# Fixture provenance

`google-appendix-a-orders.md` is the `tables/orders.md` example from Appendix A of Google's Open Knowledge Format v0.1 Draft specification, retrieved 2026-07-23:

https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog/blob/main/okf/SPEC.md

It is retained as a compatibility fixture and should be refreshed deliberately when a newer OKF codec is introduced.
